name: Loremaster Trigon

abilities.name: Quick Shot
abilities.description: Basic ranged attack dealing moderate magic damage.

abilities.name: Powerful Barrage
abilities.description: Loremaster Trigon targets one person and fires three projectiles that deal minor magic damage with a fourth projectile dealing moderate magic damage and slowing for 1 second in a cone area. This can be interrupted to stagger Loremaster Trigon.

abilities.name: Incunabular Storm
abilities.description: Loremaster Trigon performs a lengthy spell and throws two green orbs at a book pike in the arena which creates an Incunabular Storm, a book tornado, which slowly follows a player, dealing continuous direct low physical damage and knocking back.

abilities.name: Summon Clones
abilities.description: Loremaster Trigon teleports in the arena and creates two Loremaster Trrygon which are clones of itself that attack you. There can only be two maximum clones at a time.

notes: Before the Gold Road chapter, Loremaster Trigon wrongly summoned Seeker Sokhaj instead of Loremaster Trrygon. It had the same stats as Loremaster Trrygon however.
summary: Loremaster Trigon is a Seeker who can be found in the southeastern-most room, in the Underweave Nullifactory. It serves as one of the champions of the Underweave public dungeon.
